scene_description: A young girl in a striped shirt and pink shorts stands at a railed fence at a zoo, holding out food from a basket toward two large elephants. One elephant is reaching its trunk toward her hand to take the food. There is water and rocks visible in the background.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big gray animals near the fence.

questions.question: What is the girl doing with her hand?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the girl's hand and what she is holding out toward the elephant.

questions.question: Where is the girl standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is right in front of the girl and around her.

questions.question: What is the basket for in this picture?
sample_answers: to bring food to the elephant
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the basket the girl is holding and what she is doing with it.

questions.question: What might the elephant do next with its trunk?
sample_answers: eat the food from her hand
questions.evidence_hint: Look at where the elephant's trunk is pointing right now.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever seen an elephant at the zoo? What did it look like?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you went to the zoo or saw a big animal.
